primary_sources: Malpas Dam; Guyra dams; Puddledock emergency storage; groundwater; proposed Oaky River Dam restoration/transfer
known_capacity_or_scale: Malpas about 13 GL current storage with expansion capability to ~26 GL; dry-year Armidale demand stated as 4.48 GL/year
augmentation_or_option: Stage 1 Oaky River Dam restoration + 54 km pipeline to Armidale WTP + Uralla connection; Stage 2 Malpas spillway +6.5 m and trunk-main upgrade
notes: NSW has assessed the current system at highest water-security risk. Oaky is prioritised because its catchment provides more reliable yield than simply enlarging Malpas. Council evidence says the full package may leave ~4 GL/year spare capacity, while peak NEREZ construction demand could exceed four times that across Armidale-Uralla-Walcha: future industrial/energy growth is therefore water-constrained unless additional solutions emerge.
